verdict.rationale: cubic is an agentic AI code-review product, so letting users plug external MCP servers into its review agents is a fair axis. The evidence only shows cubic exposing its own MCP server to coding agents (server role) plus fixed first-party integrations such as Jira, Linear, Notion, Confluence and Datadog. Nothing shows cubic acting as an MCP client that can consume tools from user-supplied MCP servers.
